Patch 0.27.5 (Explicit remote action starts can refresh a new swing or cast)

  • Explicit starts can refresh again: Explicit remote attack and ability events can now restart nearby action presentation even if that actor was already in an ATTACKING pose from the previous action.
  • Fast sequences stay readable: This keeps fast back-to-back remote swings and casts readable after the 0.27.4 duplicate-confirmation fix stopped generic sync from stretching one action forever.
  • Sync confirmations still stay calm: Later replicated ATTACKING confirmations still stay idempotent, but real explicit action-start messages now re-arm the visual cadence for a new move.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for explicit remote action refresh handling and 0.27.5 version presentation.

Patch 0.27.4 (Duplicate remote attack confirmations no longer overextend the same swing)

  • One swing stays one swing: Duplicate remote attack confirmations now stop re-extending the same local attack pose when they are only confirming a swing that is already in progress.
  • Less stretched melee presentation: This reduces overstretched remote swing visuals when explicit attack events and later replicated ATTACKING state both describe the same melee action.
  • Fresh timers stay meaningful: The client now only starts a fresh remote attack timer when a nearby actor was not already attacking.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for duplicate remote attack sequencing and 0.27.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.27.3 (Remote attack recovery now follows server states immediately)

  • Recovery state is authoritative again: Remote players now accept server recovery states immediately after an attack instead of waiting for a client-side attack timer to expire.
  • Fewer stuck swing reads: This reduces cases where nearby actors look stuck swinging after the server has already moved them back to idle or movement.
  • Client timer stops yielding to stale pose lock: The client now clears local remote attack timers when authoritative non-attack states arrive.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for remote attack recovery sequencing and 0.27.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.27.2 (Remote charge states now keep charge-style motion presentation)

  • Charge presentation keeps priority: Remote charge-state actors now keep their run-style presentation when the server says they are charging instead of falling back to a stationary attack loop.
  • Fighter rushes read truer: This makes fighter charge-type abilities read more truthfully on nearby clients while the server is still driving the actual movement path.
  • Replication layering stays explicit: The client now treats replicated charging as higher-priority presentation than generic ATTACKING for remote actors.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for remote charge animation priority and 0.27.2 version presentation.

Patch 0.27.1 (Remote ability casts now face their accepted target immediately)

  • Cast facing lands sooner: Remote ability casts now rotate nearby remote players toward the accepted cast target before later movement or state packets arrive.
  • Spell intent reads cleaner: Projectile shots, support casts, and ground-targeted spells now read with cleaner intent because the caster no longer appears to fire sideways for a beat.
  • Replication pass stays incremental: This tightens remote spell readability on top of the new explicit basic-attack replication instead of waiting for the broader 0.28 presentation pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for remote ability facing sync and 0.27.1 version presentation.

Patch 0.27.0 (Remote basic attacks now replicate as immediate action starts)

  • Attack start is explicit: Remote basic attacks now broadcast an explicit attack-start event instead of waiting for later damage or state side effects.
  • Remote swings read sooner: Other clients now rotate nearby remote players into their swing target and kick the attack animation immediately when the server accepts the hit attempt.
  • Smaller intent-to-impact gap: This narrows the gap between remote melee intent and visible impact before the later broader action-replication pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for explicit remote basic-attack replication and 0.27.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.26.0 (Large overworld corrections stop hard-snapping the local view)

  • Authority stays server-side: Large self movement corrections still apply the server position immediately for gameplay truth.
  • View snaps less: After a big overworld correction, the local player mesh and locked camera now ease into the corrected position over a short visual window instead of popping there in one frame.
  • Jump path keeps priority: Authoritative jump visuals still override the new correction smoothing so airborne travel does not get a second conflicting interpolation pass.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for self-correction visual smoothing, correction expiry, jump-priority handling, and 0.26.0 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.4 (The daily return loop now has a real closeout guide and QA route)

  • Help screen closeout: Help now includes a Daily Return Loop reference that ties together the Journal ladder, ET reset clock, nearby party reward bonus, and Trading House circulation path.
  • Retention loop stays grounded: The guide only points at systems that already exist in the game, so the 0.25 closeout explains the real sticky loop instead of promising fake weekly sludge.
  • Release QA route recorded: Added a dedicated 0.25 retention QA checklist covering Journal reset timing, party bonus visibility, dungeon rerun ladder, and Trading House flow.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for the Daily Return Loop help reference and 0.25.4 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.3 (Daily reset messaging now runs off the real server clock)

  • Authoritative reset timing: Quest Journal reset messaging now runs off authoritative server time instead of a static daily-reset sentence.
  • Live ladder countdown: Repeatable ladder copy now shows exactly how long remains before the next reset, giving live-ops and tuning work a truthful clock to point at.
  • Clock stays honest: The HUD clock now reads from the same server-time feed, so daily reset messaging and the visible clock stop drifting apart.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for authoritative reset countdown rendering, journal refresh on server-time ticks, and 0.25.3 version presentation.

Patch 0.25.2 (The Quest Journal now shows the repeatable ladder worth coming back for)

  • Daily ladder is visible: Quest Journal now surfaces a repeatable ladder summary for the highest-value daily quests instead of hiding the best return loop behind accepted-only entries.
  • Status reads clearly: The journal now shows which top dailies are Active, Ready, or still Available, along with a quick accepted-versus-ready count.
  • 0.25 retention loop pass: This gives max-level players a visible come-back-tomorrow XP ladder without adding fake mobile-style sludge systems.
  • Regression coverage: Added regression coverage for repeatable ladder journal rendering, high-value daily visibility, and 0.25.2 version presentation.
